//: Type-check-only config for the server TEST files (vitest transpiles them but never type-checks). The build config (tsconfig.server.json) excludes *.test.ts so dist/ stays test-free; this one includes them so `npm run typecheck` covers the full server surface. Tests run under vitest (esbuild bundler resolution), not node directly, so bundler resolution checks real type errors without the NodeNext extensionless-import strictness vitest ignores.
